question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them contains a grammatical error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options.

I cannot find/the book everywhere/in the house;/ it seems to have disappeared.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the phrase "the book everywhere." The word "everywhere" is incorrectly used here. The correct structure should be "find the book anywhere," as "anywhere" is used to express the idea of a location in a negative context, which fits the meaning of the sentence.
 
• The correct phrase should be "I cannot find the book anywhere in the house," which makes the sentence grammatically correct and meaningful.
 
• Other parts of the sentence are grammatically correct and do not need any changes.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I cannot find the book anywhere in the house; it seems to have disappeared."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "in the house;" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not need any changes.
 
• **Option 2: "it seems to have disappeared." **– This part is correct and appropriately expresses the idea of the book disappearing.
 
• **Option 4: "I cannot find" **– This part is grammatically correct and does not need any changes.
